title: Enforce no-network and no-text privacy tests
description:
Add privacy enforcement tests mirroring the existing no-source-code-leakage spec pattern: a static test asserting no network-capable imports (net, http, https, dgram, fetch, undici, axios) appear under src/sentiment/**; tests asserting all output builders (text and json) and the scan-state store contain no verbatim message text — counts, hashes, and watermarks only. Local-only is a product guarantee, not a convention.

Done when: the tests are green in CI and fail if any network import or text leak is introduced.
